channel.title: The Hockey News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Hockey News (thehockeynews.com)

item.title: Crosby Out, McDavid Captain For Canada's Olympic Semifinal Vs. Finland
item.description: Sidney Crosby will not dress for Canada in their semifinal matchup after suffering a lower-body injury in their quarterfinal. Connor McDavid will wear the captain's 'C' on Friday.

item.title: NHL Rumor Roundup: Does Vladislav Gavrikov Want Out Of New York? Can The Canucks Move Evander Kane?
item.description: It's speculated that New York Rangers defenseman Vladislav Gavrikov isn't happy with the club's direction. Meanwhile, it remains to be seen if the Vancouver Canucks can find a trade partner for Evander Kane.

item.title: NHL Draft: Determination, Focus And Taylor Swift Fuel Alberts Smits' Rise To Stardom
item.description: Latvian defenseman Alberts Smits has already played in the Olympics, world juniors and Finland's top pro level in his NHL draft year. What has been his mindset on and off the ice?

item.title: Former NHLers, Team Finland React To Late Penalty In Semifinal Loss To Canada
item.description: On top of Finnish hockey legend Teemu Selanne criticizing a high-sticking penalty on Niko Mikkola, and former Canadian Olympian Chris Pronger replying to him, two Finnish players in the semifinal loss were also blunt after the game.

item.title: Canada's 'Three Macs' Super Line Is 'Doing Ridiculous Things Out There'
item.description: Connor McDavid, Nathan MacKinnon and Macklin Celebrini have been the go-to super line whenever Team Canada needs a goal at these Olympics. That combination drew massive praise from Sam Bennett and other Canadians.

item.title: Team Canada Rallies For Sidney Crosby As Coach Comments On His Injury Status
item.description: As Team Canada waits to find out whether Sidney Crosby will play in the gold medal game, two of his teammates said the team gave its all for him in the semifinal.

item.title: Canada's Other Nuclear Line Caused The Most Havoc In Olympic Semifinal Win
item.description: Sam Bennett, Brad Marchand and Tom Wilson all secretly hoped they would play together on a line for Canada. From the moment they got their wish on Friday, they were "massively effective."

item.title: The Hockey News Big Show Live At The Games: Reaction As Canada-USA Gold Medal Game Is Set
item.description: Join the chat as Andrew McInnis, Michael Augello and Ryan Kennedy recap Canada beating Finland and Team USA defeating Slovakia.

item.title: 'It's A Great Opportunity To Beat Them': Team USA Is Ready For Canada In Olympic Men's Hockey Final
item.description: Quinn Hughes didn't get to play in last year's 4 Nations Face-Off, when Team USA beat Canada in Montreal, and the Canadians won the final. Now, he and his teammates get the opportunity they wanted to face Canada in Milan.

item.title: Olympic Men's Hockey: Predicting The Gold And Bronze Medal Games
item.description: Canada and the United States will face off in a highly anticipated gold medal game, while Finland and Slovakia will battle for bronze. Who will win each matchup? Adam Proteau makes his predictions.
